title: UK sector remembers Mark Garratt
summary_en: The UK’s international education sector is paying tribute to Mark Garratt, a widely respected figure in higher education marketing, recruitment and communications, remembered for his good humour, generosity and commitment to others.
author: The PIE News team

title: Canada’s language students fall 13%
summary_en: The Canadian language sector has reached a “state of crisis” as immigration policies drive another year of declining students.
author: Polly Nash

title: New Zealand targets outcomes as international education demand accelerates
summary_en: As demand spikes and public support holds firm, New Zealand’s international education sector has a crucial chance to show it can deliver real outcomes.
author: Kim Martin
title_cn: New Zealand targets outcomes as international education demand accelerates

title: Crizac agrees Inova deal to expand Mexican, European reach
summary_en: The student recruitment platform will strengthen its presence in Mexico and enter the Netherlands as a destination market through the proposed acquisition.

title: Sudanese students to appeal after UK court upholds visa brake
summary_en: Sudan Scholars UK says students with full scholarships at Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial and UCL are unable to begin master’s courses in September and will pursue an appeal.

title: Four in five Indian study-abroad aspirants plan to return home
summary_en: Oxford International’s latest mobility survey reveals a more independent, first-generation cohort pursuing postgraduate education overseas, as rising costs, tighter immigration policies and expanding opportunities at home reshape Indian student ambitions.
author: Abhishek Nair
